sector: Seismic equipment: geophones, geophone strings and cables (Manesar, Haryana)

flags: RED: objects floor sits above blended fair value
AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess
model.reverse_dcf: The price asks the business to deliver 9.6 times its current free cash flow, in perpetuity.

business_stage: Mature niche (40-year seismic-equipment maker; revenue cyclical, issue funds machinery replacement)

anchor.source: Anchor portion, if any, 29-Oct-2026; trackers show no anchor reservation

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the Rs 120 upper band: Neutral value Rs 81 is 32.4% below and the Bull value Rs 116 is also below the price, so the call is Avoid. It is close to the line: at the Rs 114 floor the Neutral value is 28.9% below, which would read Neutral. No material governance or accounting issue was found. The fair value is DCF only (no listed peer reported) and credits only the Rs 5.83 cr of reported cash; if the Rs 3.75 cr of other income comes from treasury assets not visible in the tracker data, value would be higher. Figures come from public trackers because the RHP was not reachable.
reference_note: Upper band Rs 120 (fresh 23.26 lakh + OFS 5.54 lakh shares, Rs 34.56 cr). At Rs 120: market cap Rs 130.3 cr post-issue; P/E 11.2x on FY26 PAT (8.8x pre-issue); P/B about 1.1x post-issue; nil borrowings. Objects floor Rs 89.
headline: A 40-year-old Manesar maker of geophones and seismic cables that exports 84% of its sales, with a 37% EBITDA margin and no debt, priced at 11.2x FY26 earnings; but revenue fell 8% in FY26, ten customers give 73% of sales and cash flows from the operating business alone support about Rs 81 a share, so the call is Avoid at Rs 120 (Neutral at the Rs 114 floor).
red_flags: Revenue from operations Rs 49.08 cr (FY25) -> Rs 45.16 cr (FY26), -8%; PAT Rs 10.51 cr -> Rs 11.64 cr as the margin rose; seismic demand is cyclical
Top 10 customers 72.58% of FY26 revenue (90.05% in the stub), no long-term contracts; exports 84.22%; geophone strings 66.29% of revenue
Other income Rs 3.75 cr (about 24% of pre-tax profit); its source is not disclosed by trackers
FY25 buyback and Rs 7.68 cr dividend before the IPO; OFS of 5.54 lakh shares alongside the fresh issue
RHP not reachable: figures from public trackers, no page cites; fair value Rs 45 / 81 / 116 vs Rs 120 (DCF only)

strengths: EBITDA margin 37.4% and PAT margin 25.8% in FY26
weaknesses: Top 10 customers 73% of revenue, no long-term contracts
opportunities: Mineral and geothermal exploration, earthquake monitoring and defence research
New machinery and in-house gold plating improve cost and quality
